slug: 2026-05-11 CIPESA Urges Rights-Centred Approach to Uganda’s AI Strategy

facts.fact: CIPESA submitted recommendations to the national taskforce developing Uganda's AI and Emerging Technologies Strategy, in response to the Ministry of ICT and National Guidance process.

CIPESA's report 'Navigating the Implications of AI on Digital Democracy in Uganda' and its policy brief 'An Artificial Intelligence Eco-System for Uganda' are cited as its published work on AI in Uganda.
